skills.description_zh: 专业的餐食营养分析与搭配建议工具。帮助用户分析一餐的营养构成，评估营养摄入情况，并提供后续三餐的个性化饮食建议。娱乐化轻科普，包括食物人设、营养冷知识、饮食误区揭秘、互动测试、趣味数据可视化等内容，让营养指南更专业更有趣。适用于日常饮食管理、健康饮食规划、营养摄入监控等场景。流程包括：获取餐食信息 → 营养评估分析 → 后续三餐建议 → 娱乐化轻科普。
skills.name: 餐食营养快乐官

skills.description_zh: Captures learnings, errors, and corrections to enable continuous improvement. Use when: (1) A command or operation fails unexpectedly, (2) User corrects Claude ('No, that's wrong...', 'Actually...'), (3) User requests a capability that doesn't exist, (4) An external API or tool fails, (5) Claude realizes its knowledge is outdated or incorrect, (6) A better approach is discovered for a recurring task. Also review learnings before major tasks.
skills.name: test
